decisions.summary: docs/pre-release-remediation.md item numbers are load-bearing — cited by exact number from README, SECURITY.md, src/, and the installers. Never renumber.
Deleting hooks/hooks.json was correct: nothing referenced it, and install.sh writes hook config into settings.json inline, so it was a dead second source of truth.

The store lock covers every mutating CLI command, not just --expect-rev, because SECURITY.md/README promise general serialization. Read-only commands stay unlocked so `status` does not create .claude-task/.
